grammarFocus: 基础时态、问句、名词数量和常见从句综合复习。
title: Pool Training: A Morning at the Swimming Pool
instructions: 这是一份模拟的英语听力与阅读练习材料，适合B1水平学习者。请先听录音（或阅读听力原文），然后完成10道题目。题目类型包括单选、填空、匹配和判断正误/未提及。所有答案必须来自材料原文。注意：本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
transcript:
M: Good morning, everyone. Welcome to the community pool. My name is David, and I'm the pool manager. Before you start swimming, I need to tell you a few important rules. First, the pool opens at 7 a.m. and closes at 9 p.m. on weekdays. On weekends, we open at 8 a.m. and close at 8 p.m. Second, children under 12 must always swim with an adult. Third, please take a shower before you enter the pool. Fourth, you cannot bring food or glass bottles into the pool area. Water in plastic bottles is fine. 
W: Excuse me, David. Can I ask a question? 
M: Of course. Go ahead. 
W: Is there a swimming lesson for beginners this week? 
M: Yes, there is. The beginner class is on Tuesday and Thursday at 6 p.m. It lasts for 45 minutes. The cost is 10 dollars per lesson. You can pay at the front desk. 
W: Great. And do I need to bring my own towel? 
M: Yes, you do. We don't provide towels. But you can rent a locker for 2 dollars. 
W: Okay. One more thing: is the pool water warm? 
M: The water temperature is usually 28 degrees Celsius. It's comfortable for most people. 
W: Thank you. That's very helpful. 
M: You're welcome. Enjoy your swim!

questions.prompt: What time does the pool open on weekdays?
questions.explanation: 听力中男士说：'the pool opens at 7 a.m. and closes at 9 p.m. on weekdays.' 因此工作日开放时间是早上7点。
questions.evidence: the pool opens at 7 a.m. and closes at 9 p.m. on weekdays

questions.prompt: On weekends, what time does the pool close?
questions.explanation: 男士提到：'On weekends, we open at 8 a.m. and close at 8 p.m.' 所以周末关闭时间是晚上8点。
questions.evidence: On weekends, we open at 8 a.m. and close at 8 p.m.

questions.prompt: Who must swim with an adult?
questions.explanation: 男士说：'children under 12 must always swim with an adult.' 因此12岁以下的儿童必须由成人陪同。
questions.evidence: children under 12 must always swim with an adult

questions.prompt: What is NOT allowed in the pool area?
questions.explanation: 男士说：'you cannot bring food or glass bottles into the pool area. Water in plastic bottles is fine.' 所以玻璃瓶不允许带入。
questions.evidence: you cannot bring food or glass bottles into the pool area

questions.prompt: The beginner swimming class is on Tuesday and Thursday at ______ p.m. (Write ONE number)
questions.explanation: 女士问是否有初学者课程，男士回答：'The beginner class is on Tuesday and Thursday at 6 p.m.' 因此填6。
questions.evidence: The beginner class is on Tuesday and Thursday at 6 p.m.

questions.prompt: The cost of each beginner lesson is ______ dollars. (Write ONE number)
questions.explanation: 男士说：'The cost is 10 dollars per lesson.' 所以每节课费用是10美元。
questions.evidence: The cost is 10 dollars per lesson.

questions.prompt: What does the pool provide for free?
questions.explanation: 女士问是否需要自带毛巾，男士说：'Yes, you do. We don't provide towels. But you can rent a locker for 2 dollars.' 毛巾不提供，储物柜要租，所以没有免费提供的东西。
questions.evidence: We don't provide towels. But you can rent a locker for 2 dollars.

questions.prompt: How much does it cost to rent a locker?
questions.explanation: 男士说：'you can rent a locker for 2 dollars.' 所以租储物柜需要2美元。
questions.evidence: you can rent a locker for 2 dollars

questions.prompt: What is the water temperature usually?
questions.explanation: 男士说：'The water temperature is usually 28 degrees Celsius.' 因此水温通常是28摄氏度。
questions.evidence: The water temperature is usually 28 degrees Celsius.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: The pool provides swimming caps for free.
questions.explanation: 听力中只提到不提供毛巾，可以租储物柜，但没有提到是否免费提供泳帽。因此是Not Given。
questions.evidence: No information about swimming caps is given in the transcript.

grammar.title: 基础时态、问句、名词数量和常见从句综合复习
grammar.explanation: 本部分复习一般现在时（表示规则和事实）、一般疑问句（用Can I...? / Do I...?）、名词数量（如children under 12, 10 dollars）以及常见从句（如before you enter the pool）。
grammar.example: Children under 12 must always swim with an adult.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence in the present simple tense.
options: The pool is open at 7 a.m. every day.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时中，主语The pool是第三人称单数，动词open要加-s，所以是opens。
情态动词can引导的一般疑问句结构是：Can + 主语 + 动词原形？所以'Can I ask a question?'是正确的。

questions.prompt: There are two ______ in the pool. (child)
questions.explanation: child的复数形式是不规则变化children。
questions.evidence: children under 12 must always swim with an adult

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a clause.
options: Please take a shower before you enter the pool.
Please take a shower before you entering the pool.
Please take a shower before enter the pool.
Please take a shower before you enters the pool.
answers: Please take a shower before you enter the pool.
questions.explanation: before引导时间状语从句，从句主语是you，动词用原形enter。
questions.evidence: Please take a shower before you enter the pool.
